verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser's own docs describe HyperAgent as its "open-source" Playwright AI framework, and its MCP server has a public GitHub repo. The core managed cloud browser platform (sessions, scrape/crawl/extract APIs, sandboxes) shows no evidence of published source, and no specific open license is named for any component. missing for 10: source availability for the core cloud platform, a named open license for HyperAgent or the MCP repo, independent confirmation of the license terms.
